{{Top|leg}}
A '''concussion rocket''' was a small non-lethal explosive designed for use with personal weapon systems. This [[Wrist rocket/Legends|wrist rocket]] was generally used to knock down and disorient an opponent. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Mira]] was known to use this type of weapon toward the end of the [[Dark Wars]].
